title: Global shtukas and Langlands over function fields, Part II: Ramanujan and Arthur weight constraints
summary: Part II of GlobalShtukasAndFunctionFieldLanglands, starting where that roadmap stops: the parent constructs V. Lafforgue's semisimple global parameters of cuspidal representations and their local–global compatibility, and this roadmap uses Deligne's theory of weights on those parameters to constrain the local components. It plans Ciubotaru–Harris's generic Ramanujan theorem over function fields (a cuspidal representation of an absolutely simple group that is generic at one unramified place and tempered or discrete series at another is tempered at every unramified place), their propagation of complementary series indexed by nilpotent orbits and the elimination of extraneous points (verifying Arthur's weight prediction under hypotheses), together with the arithmetic inputs they need: geometric local parameters, Li-Huerta's comparison of local parameters, the Gan–Harris–Sawin Weil–Deligne purity of discrete series, Xue's parametrization of Hecke quotients and the Lafforgue–Zhu elliptic decomposition.

# Global shtukas and Langlands over function fields, Part II: Ramanujan and Arthur weight constraints

Part II of GlobalShtukasAndFunctionFieldLanglands. The parent ends with Lafforgue's global parameters, their excursion operators and their semisimple local–global compatibility (GS.5–GS.7). This roadmap starts there and plans the weight-theoretic consequences proved by Ciubotaru and Harris: the generic Ramanujan theorem and the Arthur-type propagation of complementary series, with their arithmetic inputs. The local half of their paper (nilpotent orbits, weight filtrations, the generic and complementary spherical unitary duals) is planned in LieHighestWeightPartII and SmoothRepresentationsOfLocalGroupsPartII and imported. Layers: RA.0 geometric and pure local parameters; RA.1 weights of local systems on curves; RA.2 rational Satake classes; RA.3 local parametrization and geometric representations; RA.4 discrete series; RA.5 the generic Ramanujan theorem; RA.6 elliptic parameters and stack purity; RA.7 Arthur parameters and the discrete spectrum; RA.8 weight patterns and Arthur-type propagation. Not planned here: counting local systems, crystalline companions, special cycles and higher Siegel–Weil, Tate cohomology and cyclic base change, Ĝ-valued potential automorphy (proposed as separate Part IIs).

stages.title: Geometric local parameters and pure Weil–Deligne parameters
stages.description: **Targets.** Geometric L-homomorphisms of a local Weil group (Ciubotaru–Harris Definition 2.5): Frobenius eigenvalues in a faithful representation are Weil q-numbers of integer weight, independently of the representation and of the Frobenius lift. Pure Weil–Deligne representations and LG-valued parameters (Definition 2.6 with the sign correction E9; Gan–Harris–Sawin Definition 3.3), their equivalence with essentially tempered L-parameters and the uniqueness of pure completions (Gan–Harris–Sawin Lemma 3.5).

stages.title: Weights of ℓ-adic local systems on curves
stages.description: **Targets.** L. Lafforgue's decomposition of a lisse sheaf by constant-field twist classes (Corollaire VII.8, Ciubotaru–Harris (5.5)); propagation of geometricity from one boundary place, with the weight filtration and the purity of its graded pieces as Weil–Deligne representations at the boundary (Ciubotaru–Harris Proposition 2.7); Sawin–Templier's purity of Ĝ-valued local systems whose image lies in no proper parabolic (Lemma 11.4) and its local consequence (Gan–Harris–Sawin Lemma 3.6, Corollary 3.8).

stages.title: Rational Satake classes of cuspidal parameters
stages.description: **Targets.** The relation 'π belongs to σ' between cuspidal representations and Lafforgue's parameters, the local systems L(π, τ) (Ciubotaru–Harris Definition 3.7, (5.3)); algebraicity of Lafforgue's Satake classes and their equality with Frobenius classes (Theorem 3.6 with Lemmas 3.2 and 3.5); the real part ν_w of a Satake class and its half-integrality when weights are integral ((5.1), (5.6)).

stages.title: Local semisimple parameters and geometric representations
stages.description: **Targets.** Li-Huerta's uniformization of global shtukas by local shtukas and his local–global compatibility (Theorems A and C): the Genestier–Lafforgue and Fargues–Scholze semisimple parameters agree; the properties of the semisimple local parametrization (Ciubotaru–Harris Theorem 3.8; Gan–Harris–Sawin Theorem 2.3); geometric representations (Definition 3.9) and their stability under Galois conjugation, induction, Jacquet modules, products and twists, with tori and central characters (Proposition 3.10(1)–(4)).

stages.title: Discrete series: globalization, purity and Galois conjugation
stages.description: **Targets.** ι-tempered and ι-discrete representations (Definition 4.1); the Gan–Harris–Sawin globalizations with irreducible global parameter (Proposition 3.9, Proposition 3.11, Beuzart-Plessis's Lemma A.1) and the Weil–Deligne purity of discrete series (Theorem 1.2, Corollary 3.12); geometricity of discrete series (Proposition 3.10(5)); Galois conjugation of discrete series with algebraic models (Theorem 4.2, second assertion) and embedding independence of temperedness for geometric components (Theorem 4.3 under its geometricity hypothesis).

stages.title: The generic Ramanujan theorem
stages.description: **Targets.** The test representations of the dual group (the table after Theorem 5.4), the lift of a parameter to the L-group of the adjoint group over a finite extension (p. 14, footnote 6, extended to types A, B and E₇ by E12), integrality of Frobenius weights from a tempered or discrete-series place, Theorem 5.4 with the scope corrections E11 and E13, and Corollary 5.7 (propagation of genericity).

stages.title: Elliptic parameters and the stack-purity route
stages.description: **Targets.** Elliptic global parameters and their temperedness at unramified places (Sawin–Templier Lemmas 11.4–11.5, Lafforgue–Zhu §3); the Lafforgue–Zhu decomposition over elliptic parameters (Proposition 1.2); realisability in stack cohomology (Expectation 5.9) and integrality of the weights of realisable sheaves (Sketch 5.10, after Sun's Theorem 2.11).

stages.title: Arthur parameters and parametrization of the discrete spectrum
stages.description: **Targets.** Global Arthur parameters over a function field and Arthur's weight prediction at unramified places in Clozel's form (Conjectures 1.3, 1.8, Expectation 1.9, recorded as predicates); compatible global parameters of discrete representations and the parametrization hypotheses (Conjectures 9.1, 9.5, Definition 9.4); rationality of the discrete spectrum under Conjecture 9.1 (Lemma 9.2); Xue's parametrization of finite-codimension Hecke quotients of compactly supported forms (Theorem 3.6.7).

stages.title: Weight patterns, Property A and Arthur-type propagation
stages.description: **Targets.** Global weight patterns; propagation of complementary series (Theorem 1.11, with the scope corrections PAPER-CIUBOTARU-HARRIS-26/E1 and E18 and gap G4); the weight array at a ramified place ((10.4)–(10.6)); Property A and the example of Remark 10.8; the weight certificates excluding extraneous points (proof of Theorem 10.3, corrected by E3 and E5) and the elimination of extraneous points (Theorem 10.3, Remark 10.7).
